capabilities: Chat with AI providers inside Obsidian
Connect external MCP agents like Claude Desktop and Codex CLI to the vault
Search notes semantically with local embeddings
Convert PDF and audio files to Markdown notes
Manage agent workspaces, tasks, and skills
extras: README contains a detailed network-use disclosure listing every external request the plugin can make and what triggers it; legacy Claudesidian installs in .obsidian/plugins/claudesidian-mcp/ keep working; several sub-features (web capture, PDF/audio ingestion, data analysis, mobile) are marked experimental; links to Synaptic Labs' paid 'Your AI Second Brain' course.
intentEvidence: Nexus is the successor to Claudesidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way for AI agents to read, search, and manage vault notes, and wiring up external assistants like Claude Desktop normally takes manual configuration.

relations.evidence: Nexus is the successor to Claudesidian.

requires.name: AI provider API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, etc.)
MCP client such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, or Codex CLI for external-agent use

summary: AI agent hub that adds native chat with multiple providers and exposes the vault to MCP clients and CLI agents for reading, searching, and editing notes.
